description: Expected values for the app (JA-8). Generated from docs/data by method/tests/make_expected.py.

rules.area_value: sum of viirs_eq over the cells whose centre is inside the rectangle (DE-13); null if the month has no data (empty viirs_eq), never 0
rules.area_variance: sum of viirs_eq_var over the same cells; 90 % interval = value +/- 1.645*sqrt(var) (DE-16)
rules.median: median of the area values of the same calendar month in all previous years with data (DE-13); even count -> mean of the two middle values; null if no previous year has data
rules.n_years: number of previous years used for the median (the app may hide medians below a minimum N)
rules.anomaly_ratio: value / median, only when median > 0, else null
rules.cell_centre: row, col = cell_id.split('_'); lat = (row + 0.5) * size - 90; lon = (col + 0.5) * size - 180
rules.tolerance: values are sums of the same file's numbers; compare with a relative tolerance of 1e-9

areas.name: high_fire_2deg
areas.selection: 2x2 degree square with the highest total of observed months

areas.name: low_fire_2deg
areas.selection: 2x2 degree square with the lowest non-zero total of observed months
